comments.body:
Thanks for the suggestions, all applied in 7585da6:

- `isInStore` now uses a small `isSubpath` helper (exact match or separator-bounded prefix, `filepath.Abs` on the base, empty base returns false) for both the root store and mounts.
- `TestBinaryCopyStorePathBoundaries` captures `out.Stdout`, uses a small case slice instead of the map lookup, and asserts `isInStore(filepath.Dir(storePath))` is false and `isInStore(filepath.Join(storePath, "..hidden"))` is true.

`go test ./internal/action -run Binary` passes; gofmt is clean.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
